title: Raja Amer Khan v. Federation
holding: Supreme Court is not bound to follow the Code of Civil Procedure 1908 or Code of Criminal Procedure 1898 relating to its own practice and procedure; Article 191; Supreme Court Rules 1980.

title: Gul Tiaz Khan Marwat
holding: Review Order XXVI Supreme Court Rules 1980; Order XLVII Rule 1 CPC; mistake or error apparent on the face of the record.

title: Shuhada Forum
holding: Pakistan Army Act 1952 ss.2(1)(d), 59(4); court martial of civilians; Article 184(3).

title: Abdullah v. Waryam
holding: Title dispute; mutation by fraud; section 9 CPC; section 172 Land Revenue Act; declaration and permanent injunction.

title: Muhammad Aslam Mianoor v. Pakistan Cables
holding: Civil Procedure Code O.XXXIX, Rr.1, 2 & 4 Specific Relief Act Ss. 42, 54 & 55
